Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring voters to show photo identification and proof of voter registration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voter requirements; and amending RCW 29A.44.210.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.44.210 and 2003 c 111 s 1120 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person desiring to vote at any primary or election mustshow proof of voter registration. (2) Any person desiring to vote at any primary or election isrequired to sign his or her name on the appropriate precinct list ofregistered voters. If the voter registered using a mark, or can nolonger sign his or her name, the election officers shall require thevoter to be identified by another registered voter. (3) Any person desiring to vote at any primary or election mustshow photo identification. (4) The precinct election officers shall then record the voter'sname.
